messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D knight-fighting game for phones and tablets.

## Requirements
- “Make a game knights fighting (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)”
- Build it now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for visual checks and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created a browser-based Three.js arena duel called **IRON OATH**, with a player knight, AI Warden, responsive touch controls, and keyboard controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added game UI, styling, 3D scene, knight models, combat loop, enemy AI, health/stamina, pause/restart, and keyboard/touch controls.
- Served locally at `http://localhost:3002`; checked desktop and mobile screenshots at `screenshots/iron-oath.jpg`.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Added a data-URI favicon after browser checks reported a favicon 404.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Optionally recheck the latest page after the favicon update and run a brief mobile/desktop combat smoke test.
2. Summarize the delivered game and note the assumptions when finishing.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game structure, HUD, title/pause overlays, controls, Three.js entry point.
- `style.css`: Responsive desktop/mobile layout and visual design.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, knights, controls, AI, combat, and animation.
- `screenshots/iron-oath.jpg`: Latest visual check screenshot (untracked/possibly ignored).

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Browser screenshot checks showed the arena and mobile layout; no gameplay errors were observed. Playwright initially reported a missing favicon, which was addressed in `index.html`.
